keyVerseDR: "...he had compassion on them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd..." (Mk 6:34)

level1.title: Come and Rest
level1.story: The Apostles came back tired. Jesus said, "Come and rest a while." But crowds came, and Jesus felt sorry for them and taught them.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Where did Jesus take His friends?
When do you rest with Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, my Shepherd, take care of me. Amen.

activity.title: A quiet place
activity.intro: Draw the quiet place by the lake where Jesus took His friends.
activity.prompt: A quiet hillside by the Sea of Galilee, with a boat and Jesus resting with His friends

level2.title: Sheep Without a Shepherd
level2.story: The Apostles gathered around Jesus and told Him all they had done and taught. He said, "Come apart into a desert place, and rest a little." So many were coming and going that they did not even have time to eat. They went away in a boat, but the crowds ran ahead on foot and got there first. When Jesus saw the crowd, He had compassion, because they were as sheep without a shepherd, and He taught them many things.
level2.keyLine: He had compassion on them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
actions: Take a quiet prayer break daily
level2.prayer: Jesus, Good Shepherd, give me rest and a caring heart. Amen.

activity.title: Rest with Jesus
activity.intro: Jesus says, "Come and rest." Draw your prayer times on the clocks.
